title: Private per-instance fetch refs (refs/ticfac/peek/<id>/..., refs/ticfac/fetched/<id>/...) are never deleted and accumulate
body: The wdb/e09c976 fix fetches into refs named by a pid-seq instance id (reconcile/git.go:173, reconcile/tracker.go:113, runstate/store.go:349), and nothing ever deletes them: every run-epic incarnation and every `ticfac findings` call mints a new set. The operator's own checkout already holds 87 refs/ticfac/fetched/* and 121 refs/ticfac/peek/* refs, and they pin deleted attempt branches' objects against gc. Delete the private ref after reading it (or prune the instance's namespace on exit) without reintroducing a shared ref.
